title: I built a VS Code start page for my Git repositories
why_read: A small, practical VS Code extension that gives an at-a-glance dashboard of local Git repo states, useful for developers juggling many repos.
analysis: Repo Board is a VS Code extension that shows the git status (uncommitted changes, push/pull state) of multiple local repositories and worktrees in a single start page tab. The motivation is a real and relatable problem: context-switching between many clones, especially when coding agents create extra worktrees. It's a modest, unglamorous productivity tool rather than a novel technical contribution, but genuinely useful for its narrow purpose. The write-up is clear about its scope and limitations, noting the extension itself doesn't use AI despite being motivated by AI-agent workflows.
